definitions.explanation: A tabletop game played on a board, involving pieces, cards, or dice. Includes both traditional games and modern designer board games.

examples.japanese: ボードゲーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ボードゲーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed playing board games as a family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ボードゲーム⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えていて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}べる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: Board game cafes have been increasing recently, making it easy to play casually with friends.

notes:
A loanword from English 'board game.' Covers a wide range of tabletop games played on a board, from traditional games to modern hobby games.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ボードゲーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play board games
- ボードゲーム⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧: board game cafe
- ボードゲーム⟦{愛好家|あいこうか}→愛好家：15008_aikouka⟧: board game enthusiast
- ボードゲーム⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: board game tournament

TRADITIONAL JAPANESE BOARD GAMES:
- ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧: shogi (Japanese chess)
- ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧: go
- ⟦{双六|すごろく}→双六：07350_sugoroku⟧: sugoroku (Japanese backgammon-like race game)
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: Game of Life (Japanese version)
- ⟦オセロ→オセロ：05418_osero⟧: Othello/Reversi

CULTURAL NOTE:
Board game cafes (ボードゲーム⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧) have become popular in Japan since the 2010s, especially in urban areas like Tokyo and Osaka. They offer a large selection of games to play for a table fee, and have helped popularize modern European-style board games in Japan.
